name: codx-junior-installer
description: codx-junior installer is a helper to setup a new codx-junior instance.

scripts.build:base: cd codx-junior && docker-compose -f docker-compose.build.yaml build codx-junior-debian-image
scripts.build:api: cd codx-junior && docker-compose -f docker-compose.build.yaml build codx-junior-api-image
scripts.build:client: cd codx-junior && docker-compose -f docker-compose.build.yaml build codx-junior-client-image
